messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 1767777777 - Gateway error rate spike detected: 503s rising on /v1/generate (hosted). Threshold 7% crossed -> current 12%. Paging oncall.

sre-jamie: acked. looking at dashboards now. Seeing 50% of 503s from edge region eu-west-1. No deploys in the last hour.

oncall-lee: I'm on it. Can someone check if request-id propagation is intact? I see a lot of traces missing span ids in the last 30m.

eng-runtime-maya: @oncall-lee we started sampling drop for a couple of older nodes yesterday (to reduce OTEL ingestion). Might have affected trace headers. Checking.

infra-ben: no infra changes from my side. healthchecks look fine for gpu-pool-3 though. But the gateway pods show elevated 502/503 in logs.

sre-jamie: quick customer impact note: about 8% of active API keys are getting 5xx errors — some heavy customers seeing regen failures. CS looped in.

customer-success-lina: I've DM'd affected accounts, they're seeing request timeouts -> retries. Need ETA and mitigation so they can decide fallback.

support-ash: capturing a couple of example curl failures from logs:

```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
content-type: application/json
{"error":"gateway timeout","code":503}
```

sre-jamie: interestingly, logs sometimes have X-Request-ID missing. That makes tracing across services near impossible. We need a short-lived probe to re-instrument edge to inject request ids so we can correlate.

eng-runtime-maya: agree. Proposed stopgap: flip on "edge-inject-traceid" featureflag for a single edge-deployment (eu-west-1) for 15m to tag requests with X-Req-Temp and emit a lightweight debug line. Should be low-cost and reversible.

oncall-lee: do it. But let's also add a temporary trace-sampler override so we capture 100% of requests that have 503 response codes for the next 10m.

infra-ben: I can toggle the feature flag and the sampler. Will run a canary on edge-1a first. Command:

```
# toggle ff
infra-cli feature enable edge-inject-traceid --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --target=edge-1a
# set sampler
infra-cli tracing override-sampler --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --rate=1.0
```

sre-jamie: running those now. infra-ben: ping when canary is up.

infra-ben: canary toggled. logs show new header X-Req-Temp present for 1% of traffic (canary sample). No immediate errors in canary.

oncall-lee: rolling to 50% on eu-west-1. Watch for any CPU or latency regressions.

sre-jamie: watch dashboard metric gateway.error_rate and trace ingestion. Also enable ephemeral logging to capture request/response pairs but redact payloads.

eng-runtime-maya: added ephemeral debug hook on edge to emit: "DBG:REQ <X-Req-Temp> status=<code> latency_ms=<n>" to a separate debug stream.

support-ash: got a few debug lines. correlating now.

support-ash: correlation shows many 503s happen after a backend grpc pool returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for long tails ~ 250ms. Looks like transient per-shard overload.

sre-jamie: that explains it. Short term mitigation: increase backend concurrency limit and enable per-request fallback to light-weight model variant when backend returns resource_exhausted.

eng-runtime-maya: we have an emergency runtime config: route-fallback-policy can be set via deploy-config. I can push a canary that maps failing backends to fallback-model-small for 20% of traffic.

oncall-lee: do that but keep it scoped to eu-west-1 for now. Also, enable client-side exponential backoff guidance for 5xx in the API docs? CS liaise with docs team.

customer-success-lina: I'll draft a short status note for customers indicating we're seeing transient 503s, mitigation in progress, recommended retries with jitter.

infra-ben: pushed fallback route canary to 20% on eu-west-1. Observing a small drop in errors for those sessions.

sre-jamie: after 10m of instrumentation and fallback, overall 503 rate dropped from 12% to 5.5% in region. Still elevated but better. Keep sampling for traces.

eng-runtime-maya: restoring sampler to 0.2 after we've captured samples. Keeping edge-inject-traceid on for another 5m to finish correlations.

oncall-lee: preparing handoff notes for next oncall in 30m. Key points: root cause likely backend shard exhaustion causing resource_exhausted -> gateway 503. Temporary mitigations: trace injection, sampler override, fallback route.

sre-jamie: add action item: long term we need better resource throttling and queueing in grpc pool + alert when trace IDs missing on gateway responses. Also add synthetic tests for per-shard long-tail.

customer-success-lina: sent customer update. People appreciate the quick mitigation. requesting postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

support-ash: log retention for debug stream set to 24h. Exporting captured debug lines and traces to secure bucket for post-incident analysis.

incident-bot: Incident 1767777777 status: mitigated -> error rate reduced, monitoring. Next update scheduled in 30m or on any regression.

oncall-lee: handing off to @sre-jamie for next shift. Leaving a short checklist in the incident doc: revert featureflag if latency increases, follow up on postmortem items. :white_check_mark:

sre-jamie: taking over. If anything spikes, @infra-ben and @eng-runtime-maya on standby. Thanks all for quick responses. :heart:
